descriptionHtml: IAS COMRADES phase 1, an awareness program about Industry Applications Society (IAS) and other related competitions which were organized by IAS, the University of Peradeniya in collaboration with IAS, University of Moratuwa was held on 12th February 2020 at Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department seminar room. The program was carried on by Mr.Lakshitha Gunasekara, the President of the IEEE IAS Sri Lanka Chapter and Mr.Tharindu Suraj, Research Engineer- University of Moratuwa and the contest winner of Myron Zucker Design Contest and Robotics Demonstration Contest. Undergraduates of the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering were present on the occasion.
